retail.reading: Capstone and pefile over the retail executables; no retail code incorporated
retail.loop: decode while the remaining bytes (after the first sync, less a trailing 128-byte TAG) are at least the first frame's header size without padding; add the bytes the decoder consumed and produced; stop when it consumes nothing or nothing remains
retail.frame: the Layer III routine requires the 12-bit sync 0xfff at its own frame, unpacks the side information and consumes the decoder's frame size plus this frame's padding byte; the Jedi routines also return nothing for a frame that would end past the data's end (the loop's third argument, the byte before a trailing TAG); no routine reads past its frame and no loop looks for the next sync
retail.firstFrameSize: jk2mp.exe 0x45a6a0 (reached through 0x45a890 and 0x45a8f0): an MPEG-1 Layer III frame is 2880 * kbps / (rate / 50), kbps from 0x4e59a8 (0, 32, 40 ... 320) and rate / 50 from 0x4e58c8 (882, 960, 640), with no padding term: 208 for drain.mp3's first frame
retail.layer3Mpeg1Choice: jk2mp.exe Layer III init stores 0x456870 at the stream state + 8 when the header's version bit is MPEG-1 (0x457c82..0x457c8d) and 0x4572d0 otherwise; the layer table at 0x4e4c5c sends Layer III to the trampoline 0x456860 (jmp [state + 8])
retail.drainMp3: every engine decodes 93 frames: 210 bytes remain at the 93rd (>= 208), the frame ends at 19,644 <= 19,645, then 1 byte remains (< 208) and the loop stops

stvoy.exe.note: audio_decode takes (frame, pcm) only: no bound on the frame end

minimp3.fastPath: line 1723: a frame is taken directly when it ends the input or the 4 bytes after it are a compatible header (hdr_compare: valid, same version and layer, same sample rate, same free-format state)
minimp3.reset: line 1730: otherwise memset(dec, 0) clears the decoder, the bit reservoir included, and mp3d_find_frame searches
minimp3.matchFrame: mp3d_match_frame, line 1657: a frame followed by fewer than 4 bytes is refused (nmatch 0); mp3d_find_frame accepts a frame that exactly fills the input only at offset 0
minimp3.drainMp3: the 93rd frame, followed by one byte, is refused; the walker was told the 210 bytes held no frame and ended

helpers: Mp3HeaderFrameBytes: a frame's size from its header alone (MPEG-1, MPEG-2, MPEG 2.5 Layer III; Layers I-III; padding 4 bytes for Layer I, else 1); 0 for free format, invalid headers or fewer than 4 bytes
Mp3ContinuesStream: the bytes after a frame begin a sized header with the same version, layer and sample rate
change.rule: where a frame is due (the start, or just after a frame the decoder found: it reported a channel count), a complete frame that the stream does not continue is handed over alone; anywhere else, and when the stream continues, the rest of the data as before
change.users: Scan (effect and stream sizes), Read (effects, streams, Alice songs), SamplesBefore (Alice seeks); SeekFileOffset leaves the decoder to resync except at the stream start
change.firstAttempt: minimp3 clears its reservoir before searching, so a retry after a refusal would decode the frame without the earlier frames' bytes its audio begins in
change.kept: the retail size rule: a last frame shorter than the first frame's unpadded size is not decoded

differences: retail stops at the first bytes after a frame that lack the sync; Fn's decoder resyncs past them: the walker hands a frame alone 677 times in the six installations, each the last frame of drain.mp3 (Outcast, Academy) or of a F.A.K.K.2 RIFF file before its LIST chunk (framesHandedAlone)
the Jedi engines refuse a frame that would end past the data and Elite Force's decodes it, reading past the data; Fn decodes no incomplete frame (unchanged)
